ShortDescription.Value: 730 realistic American road signs with posts (regular and flashing signs).

Publish.LongDescription:
US Road Signs adds 730 freely placeable American road signs, modeled on the MUTCD (the US Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices): 365 standard signs, plus a flashing version of every one.
Every sign is a complete 3D assembly, not a flat decal. Each one has a printed sign face on a plate with real thickness, mounting bolts, and its support: a galvanized post, twin posts, a Type III barricade, a portable stand, or an in-street flexible base.
SIGN CATEGORIES Find everything in the "US Road Signs" toolbar menu: - Regulatory: stop, yield, speed limits, one way, turn restrictions, parking rules and more - Warning: curves, intersections, merges, lane drops, crossings, hills and other hazards - Guide: green guide signs - Highway: lane-use, freeway entrance, exit and service signs - Services: blue motorist service signs - School and Pedestrian: school zones, crosswalks, pedestrian and bicycle signs - Construction: orange work-zone signs, detours, flaggers, barricades and portable signs - Other: railroad signs, object markers and more
FLASHING SIGNS Every category has a matching "(Flashing)" category with LED-enhanced versions of each sign. The LEDs are built into the sign border and are real in-game lights: they flash about once a second, day and night. LED colors follow the sign's color scheme: - Amber: yellow and fluorescent yellow-green warning, school and pedestrian signs - Red: regulatory signs such as STOP, YIELD, WRONG WAY and speed limits - Orange: orange work-zone signs - White: guide, service, parking and other signs
PLACEMENT - Place signs anywhere, no road is needed. You should use the Anarchy mod if you want to place signs on top of roads. - Rotate them freely while placing, like any other prop. - Use the line and curve tools to place rows of signs. - To raise or lower a sign, use Move It. If the game won't let you place a sign near road geometry, use Anarchy.
OPTIONS Under Game Options > US Road Signs: - Standard post style: square perforated tube, galvanized U-channel, or round pipe with clamp brackets - Show or hide mounting bolts Restart the game after changing these. Signs already in your city update automatically.
